title: priceRanges: Making BEM classes more consistent
body:
I was looking at theming the priceRanges widget, and there are a few things that needs to be updated. It currently generates the following markup: ```html
Header
$3 - $13 $13 - $40
to
Footer
``` First, it seems that we have two issues: 1. The count is not displayed in the `ais-price-range--range`. 2. It seems there are way too many useless `span`s here. Do you have any idea what they are for? And I would also: * \[x] Rename the `ais-price-ranges--range` to `ais-price-ranges--item` * \[x] Wrap them in a `ais-price-ranges--list`, to stay consistent with other widgets (and being able to share styling easily). * \[x] Add `ais-price-ranges--form-label` (?) to the `label` inside the bottom `form`.
